title: Ejercicio 01
reference_query:
WITH inventario_completo AS (
    SELECT
        p.name      AS producto,
        cat.name    AS categoria,
        i.stock
    FROM inventory i
    INNER JOIN products   p   ON p.product_id   = i.product_id
    INNER JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
)
SELECT producto, categoria, stock
FROM inventario_completo
WHERE stock < 10
ORDER BY stock ASC, producto ASC;
notes: Hub USB-C 7-en-1 (product_id=10) es el unico con stock=0. Los 5 productos criticos son todos de Electronics o Toys & Games.

title: Ejercicio 02
reference_query:
WITH revenue_por_cliente AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue_total
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT
    c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name  AS nombre_completo,
    c.country,
    r.revenue_total
FROM customers c
INNER JOIN revenue_por_cliente r ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY r.revenue_total DESC
LIMIT 20;
notes: Los 20 primeros clientes son todos de Mexico. Indica alta concentracion de clientes de alto valor en ese mercado. Revenue top: ~$41K.

title: Ejercicio 03
reference_query:
WITH unidades_vendidas AS (
    SELECT
        cat.name                AS categoria,
        SUM(oi.quantity)        AS unidades_vendidas
    FROM order_items oi
    INNER JOIN products   p   ON p.product_id   = oi.product_id
    INNER JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
    GROUP BY cat.name
),
unidades_devueltas AS (
    SELECT
        cat.name            AS categoria,
        -- SUM(oi.quantity) cuenta unidades físicas devueltas, no eventos de devolución.
        -- COUNT contaría 1 por fila aunque quantity > 1 — subestimaría el ratio real.
        SUM(oi.quantity)    AS unidades_devueltas
    FROM returns r
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id   = r.order_id
                              AND oi.product_id = r.product_id
    INNER JOIN products    p  ON p.product_id   = oi.product_id
    INNER JOIN categories  cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
    GROUP BY cat.name
)
SELECT
    uv.categoria,
    uv.unidades_vendidas,
    COALESCE(ud.unidades_devueltas, 0)           AS unidades_devueltas,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COALESCE(ud.unidades_devueltas, 0)
        / NULLIF(uv.unidades_vendidas, 0),
        2
    )                                            AS ratio_devolucion_pct
FROM unidades_vendidas uv
LEFT JOIN unidades_devueltas ud ON ud.categoria = uv.categoria
WHERE uv.unidades_vendidas >= 10
ORDER BY ratio_devolucion_pct DESC;
notes: El expected_result canónico para el sistema de validacion es expected_rows_CORRECTED. El expected_rows_AS_WRITTEN se documenta como referencia del bug IMP-14 para el teacher.

title: Ejercicio 04
reference_query:
WITH metricas_producto AS (
    SELECT
        p.name                                         AS producto,
        SUM(oi.quantity)                               AS unidades_vendidas,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2)     AS revenue_total,
        ROUND(
            SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)
            / NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity), 0),
            2
        )                                              AS precio_prom_venta
    FROM order_items oi
    INNER JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY p.name
)
SELECT producto, unidades_vendidas, revenue_total, precio_prom_venta
FROM metricas_producto
ORDER BY revenue_total DESC
LIMIT 15;
notes: La Laptop Lenovo lidera con mas de $864K de revenue historico. Los 4 primeros productos concentran el 27% del revenue total (~$10.2M). Revenue total historico en order_items: ~$10.18M.

title: Ejercicio 05
reference_query:
WITH ventas_diarias AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        p.name                              AS producto,
        cat.name                            AS categoria,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity) / 90.0, 2)  AS ventas_diarias_prom
    FROM order_items oi
    INNER JOIN products   p   ON p.product_id   = oi.product_id
    INNER JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
    INNER JOIN orders     o   ON o.order_id     = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.ordered_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, cat.name
),
cobertura AS (
    SELECT
        vd.producto,
        vd.categoria,
        i.stock                             AS stock_actual,
        vd.ventas_diarias_prom,
        ROUND(
            i.stock / NULLIF(vd.ventas_diarias_prom, 0),
            1
        )                                   AS dias_cobertura
    FROM ventas_diarias vd
    INNER JOIN inventory i ON i.product_id = vd.product_id
)
SELECT producto, categoria, stock_actual, ventas_diarias_prom, dias_cobertura
FROM cobertura
WHERE dias_cobertura < 15
   OR stock_actual = 0
ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN stock_actual = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    dias_cobertura ASC NULLS LAST;
notes: La ventana de 90 dias es relativa a CURRENT_DATE — el resultado exacto cambia si el seed se recarga en una fecha diferente. Validar usando los primeros 5 productos del orden (los mas criticos no cambian si el seed no cambia). El producto con stock=0 siempre aparece primero. En la fecha 2026-06-01 el resultado tiene 24 filas.

title: Ejercicio 06
reference_query:
WITH revenue_cliente AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue_total
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
promedio_general AS (
    SELECT AVG(revenue_total) AS promedio
    FROM revenue_cliente
)
SELECT
    c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name  AS nombre_completo,
    c.country,
    r.revenue_total
FROM customers c
INNER JOIN revenue_cliente  r ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id
CROSS JOIN promedio_general pg
WHERE r.revenue_total > 2 * pg.promedio
ORDER BY r.revenue_total DESC;
notes: 93 clientes superan el doble del promedio ($21.056). El promedio general de revenue por cliente (solo delivered) es $10.528. Los whales representan el 93/550 = 16.9% de la base de clientes.

title: Ejercicio 07
reference_query:
WITH RECURSIVE arbol AS (
    SELECT
        category_id,
        name,
        parent_id,
        1       AS nivel,
        name    AS ruta
    FROM categories_jerarquia
    WHERE parent_id IS NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        c.category_id,
        c.name,
        c.parent_id,
        a.nivel + 1,
        a.ruta || ' > ' || c.name
    FROM categories_jerarquia c
    INNER JOIN arbol a ON c.parent_id = a.category_id
)
SELECT name AS nombre, nivel, ruta
FROM arbol
ORDER BY ruta;
notes: Requiere CREATE TABLE categories_jerarquia + INSERT antes de ejecutar. Ver leccion-02.md para los datos de la tabla auxiliar. El dataset tiene 3 raices (Tecnologia, Hogar, Ropa) y 3 niveles de profundidad maxima.

title: Ejercicio 08
reference_query:
WITH RECURSIVE arbol AS (
    SELECT
        category_id,
        name,
        parent_id,
        1       AS nivel,
        name    AS ruta
    FROM categories_jerarquia
    WHERE parent_id IS NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        c.category_id,
        c.name,
        c.parent_id,
        a.nivel + 1,
        a.ruta || ' > ' || c.name
    FROM categories_jerarquia c
    INNER JOIN arbol a ON c.parent_id = a.category_id
)
SELECT name AS nombre, nivel, ruta
FROM arbol
WHERE category_id NOT IN (
    SELECT parent_id
    FROM categories_jerarquia
    WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL
)
ORDER BY ruta;
notes: Requiere CREATE TABLE categories_jerarquia + INSERT. 10 categorias hoja de 16 totales (63%). Nivel 2: Decoracion, Muebles, Ropa Hombre, Ropa Mujer. Nivel 3: Android, Auriculares, Desktops, iOS, Laptops, Parlantes.

title: Ejercicio 09
reference_query:
WITH RECURSIVE descendientes AS (
    SELECT
        category_id,
        name,
        1 AS nivel
    FROM categories_jerarquia
    WHERE category_id = 1

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        c.category_id,
        c.name,
        d.nivel + 1
    FROM categories_jerarquia c
    INNER JOIN descendientes d ON c.parent_id = d.category_id
    WHERE d.nivel < 10
)
SELECT name AS nombre, nivel
FROM descendientes
ORDER BY nivel, name;
notes: Requiere CREATE TABLE categories_jerarquia + INSERT. Incluye la raiz (Tecnologia, nivel 1). Subcategorias directas: 3 (nivel 2). Subcategorias indirectas: 6 (nivel 3).

title: Ejercicio 10
reference_query:
WITH RECURSIVE arbol AS (
    SELECT
        category_id,
        name,
        1 AS nivel
    FROM categories_jerarquia
    WHERE parent_id IS NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        c.category_id,
        c.name,
        a.nivel + 1
    FROM categories_jerarquia c
    INNER JOIN arbol a ON c.parent_id = a.category_id
)
SELECT nivel, COUNT(*) AS total_categorias
FROM arbol
GROUP BY nivel
ORDER BY nivel;
notes: Requiere CREATE TABLE categories_jerarquia + INSERT. El arbol tiene 3 niveles: 3 raices, 7 nodos intermedios, 6 hojas de nivel 3. Total: 16 categorias.

title: Ejercicio 11
reference_query:
WITH pedidos_con_monto AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.ordered_at,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS monto_pedido
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.ordered_at
),
ranking AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        ordered_at,
        monto_pedido,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id
            ORDER BY ordered_at ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM pedidos_con_monto
)
SELECT
    c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name  AS nombre_completo,
    c.country,
    r.ordered_at                        AS fecha_primer_pedido,
    r.monto_pedido
FROM ranking r
INNER JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY r.ordered_at ASC;
notes: 550 filas — una por cada cliente del seed. Todos los clientes tienen al menos un pedido delivered. El primer pedido del seed es el 2025-01-01 08:00:00. El timestamp de ordenamiento es determinante — es exact_ordered.

title: Ejercicio 12
reference_query:
WITH revenue_producto AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        p.name                                       AS producto,
        cat.name                                     AS categoria,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2)   AS revenue_total
    FROM order_items oi
    INNER JOIN products   p   ON p.product_id   = oi.product_id
    INNER JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, cat.name
),
ranking AS (
    SELECT
        producto,
        categoria,
        revenue_total,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY categoria
            ORDER BY revenue_total DESC
        ) AS posicion
    FROM revenue_producto
)
SELECT producto, categoria, revenue_total, posicion
FROM ranking
WHERE posicion <= 3
ORDER BY categoria, posicion;
notes: 3 filas por categoria, 10 categorias = 30 filas exactas. No hay empates en posicion 3 en este dataset. DENSE_RANK habria producido el mismo resultado que RANK aqui, pero es correcto usar DENSE_RANK segun el enunciado.

title: Ejercicio 13
reference_query:
WITH stock_rankeado AS (
    SELECT
        cat.name    AS categoria,
        p.name      AS producto,
        i.stock,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cat.category_id
            ORDER BY i.stock ASC
        ) AS posicion_stock
    FROM inventory i
    INNER JOIN products   p   ON p.product_id   = i.product_id
    INNER JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
)
SELECT categoria, producto, stock
FROM stock_rankeado
WHERE posicion_stock = 1
ORDER BY categoria, stock ASC;
notes: 11 filas en lugar de 10: la categoria Office tiene dos productos empatados en stock=46 (Organizador Escritorio y Lampara LED). Este empate ilustra exactamente por que el enunciado pide RANK en lugar de ROW_NUMBER.

title: Ejercicio 14
reference_query:
WITH revenue_producto AS (
    SELECT
        p.name                                       AS producto,
        cat.name                                     AS categoria,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2)   AS revenue_total
    FROM order_items oi
    INNER JOIN products   p   ON p.product_id   = oi.product_id
    INNER JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
    GROUP BY p.name, cat.name
),
ranking AS (

    FROM revenue_producto

ORDER BY posicion_global ASC;

title: Ejercicio 15
reference_query:
WITH revenue_cliente AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue_total
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered'

),
ranking AS (

title: Ejercicio 16
reference_query:
WITH stock_cuartiles AS (
    SELECT
        p.name      AS producto,
        cat.name    AS categoria,
        i.stock,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY i.stock ASC) AS cuartil
    FROM inventory i
    INNER JOIN products   p   ON p.product_id   = i.product_id
    INNER JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
)
SELECT producto, categoria, stock, cuartil
FROM stock_cuartiles
WHERE cuartil = 1
ORDER BY stock ASC;
notes: NTILE(4) sobre 90 productos: cada cuartil tiene 22 o 23 filas (90/4=22.5). El cuartil 1 tiene 23 productos (el extra va al primer grupo). Rango de stock en cuartil 1: 0 a 33. Validation_mode unordered porque NTILE no garantiza orden dentro del mismo grupo.

title: Ejercicio 17
reference_query:
WITH revenue_producto AS (
    SELECT
        oi.product_id,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue_total
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.product_id
),
cuartiles AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        revenue_total,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY revenue_total DESC) AS cuartil
    FROM revenue_producto
)
SELECT
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cuartil = 1 THEN revenue_total ELSE 0 END), 2)  AS revenue_cuartil_top,
    ROUND(SUM(revenue_total), 2)                                         AS revenue_total,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cuartil = 1 THEN revenue_total ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(revenue_total), 0),
        1
    )                                                                    AS pct_concentracion
FROM cuartiles;
notes: El 25% de productos con mas revenue (23 de 90) genera el 65.1% del revenue total. Revenue total historico en order_items: $10.18M. Cuartil top: $6.63M. Esto ilustra una distribucion de Pareto pronunciada.

title: Ejercicio 18
reference_query:
WITH revenue_producto AS (
    SELECT
        oi.product_id,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue_total
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.product_id
),
quintiles AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        revenue_total,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY revenue_total DESC) AS quintil
    FROM revenue_producto
)
SELECT
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN quintil = 1 THEN revenue_total ELSE 0 END), 2) AS revenue_quintil_top,
    ROUND(SUM(revenue_total), 2)                                        AS revenue_total,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN quintil = 1 THEN revenue_total ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(revenue_total), 0),
        1
    )                                                                   AS pct_concentracion
FROM quintiles;
notes: El 20% de productos (18 de 90) genera el 58.6% del revenue total. Revenue total identico al EJ17 ($10.18M). Quintil top: $5.96M. Comparado con EJ17 (NTILE 4, 65.1%), este resultado permite ver como la concentracion cambia al ajustar la granularidad.

title: Ejercicio 19
reference_query:
WITH revenue_mensual AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at)::DATE     AS mes,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2)  AS revenue_mes
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status     = 'delivered'
      AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01'
      AND o.ordered_at <  '2026-07-01'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at)
)
SELECT
    mes,
    revenue_mes,
    LAG(revenue_mes) OVER (ORDER BY mes)                        AS revenue_anterior,
    ROUND(
        revenue_mes - LAG(revenue_mes) OVER (ORDER BY mes),
        2
    )                                                           AS variacion_absoluta,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_mes - LAG(revenue_mes) OVER (ORDER BY mes))
        / NULLIF(LAG(revenue_mes) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 0),
        1
    )                                                           AS variacion_pct
FROM revenue_mensual
ORDER BY mes;
notes: 5 filas en lugar de 6: el seed cubre hasta mayo 2026 (generado 2026-05-31). Junio 2026 no tiene datos de pedidos delivered. Patron notable: marzo pico (+8.4%), mayo caida severa (-47.3%) — el seed termina antes de que mayo tenga datos completos. El primer mes tiene NULL en variacion (correcto). IMP-15 aplica al filtro de fecha en EJ21 pero no en este ejercicio.

title: Ejercicio 20
reference_query:
WITH ventas_diarias AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        p.name                              AS producto,
        cat.name                            AS categoria,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity) / 90.0, 2)  AS ventas_diarias_prom
    FROM order_items oi
    INNER JOIN products   p   ON p.product_id   = oi.product_id
    INNER JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
    INNER JOIN orders     o   ON o.order_id     = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.ordered_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, cat.name
),
stock_con_cobertura AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(vd.producto, p.name)       AS producto,
        COALESCE(vd.categoria, cat.name)    AS categoria,
        i.stock,
        COALESCE(vd.ventas_diarias_prom, 0) AS ventas_diarias_prom,
        ROUND(
            i.stock / NULLIF(COALESCE(vd.ventas_diarias_prom, 0), 0),
            1
        )                                   AS dias_cobertura
    FROM inventory i
    INNER JOIN products   p   ON p.product_id   = i.product_id
    INNER JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
    LEFT JOIN ventas_diarias vd ON vd.product_id = i.product_id
)
SELECT
    producto,
    categoria,
    stock,
    ventas_diarias_prom,
    dias_cobertura,
    RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            dias_cobertura ASC NULLS FIRST,
            ventas_diarias_prom DESC
    ) AS ranking_urgencia
FROM stock_con_cobertura
ORDER BY ranking_urgencia;
notes: 90 filas — toda la tabla inventory. La ventana de 90 dias es CURRENT_DATE-dependiente. Los top 5 no cambian con el seed actual porque son los productos con menor stock absoluto. NULLS FIRST en SQLite se comporta igual que en PostgreSQL para este caso (no hay NULLs en dias_cobertura de los primeros rangos).

title: Ejercicio 21
reference_query:
WITH clientes_nuevos AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name  AS nombre_completo,
        c.country,
        c.registered_at,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue_primer_mes
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN orders      o  ON o.customer_id  = c.customer_id
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id    = o.order_id
    WHERE c.registered_at  >= '2025-06-01'
      AND c.registered_at  <  '2026-06-01'  -- Filtro exclusivo: < fecha_siguiente captura todo el día N sin necesitar hora 23:59:59
      AND o.status         = 'delivered'
      AND o.ordered_at     <= c.registered_at + INTERVAL '30 days'
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.country, c.registered_at
)
SELECT
    nombre_completo,
    country,
    registered_at,
    revenue_primer_mes,
    NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY revenue_primer_mes DESC) AS cuartil
FROM clientes_nuevos
ORDER BY cuartil ASC, revenue_primer_mes DESC;
notes: 30 clientes de los 50 nuevos (sep 2025 + parte de junio 2025 - may 2026) tuvieron al menos un pedido delivered en sus primeros 30 dias. El filtro < '2026-06-01' es correcto (patron exclusivo) pero falta comentario pedagogico segun IMP-15. Los clientes de sep 2025 (premium) dominan el cuartil 1.

title: Ejercicio 22
reference_query:
WITH revenue_bruto AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue_bruto
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id    = o.order_id
    INNER JOIN customers   c  ON c.customer_id  = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.status     = 'delivered'
      AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01'
      AND o.ordered_at <  '2026-04-01'
    GROUP BY c.country
),
devoluciones AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS total_reembolsado
    FROM returns r
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id   = r.order_id
                              AND oi.product_id = r.product_id
    INNER JOIN orders      o  ON o.order_id    = r.order_id
    INNER JOIN customers   c  ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE r.status      = 'refunded'
      AND r.returned_at >= '2026-01-01'
      AND r.returned_at <  '2026-04-01'
    GROUP BY c.country
)
SELECT
    rb.country                              AS pais,
    rb.revenue_bruto,
    COALESCE(d.total_reembolsado, 0)        AS total_reembolsado,
    ROUND(
        rb.revenue_bruto - COALESCE(d.total_reembolsado, 0),
        2
    )                                       AS revenue_neto,
    RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            rb.revenue_bruto - COALESCE(d.total_reembolsado, 0) DESC
    )                                       AS posicion
FROM revenue_bruto rb
LEFT JOIN devoluciones d ON d.country = rb.country
ORDER BY posicion ASC;
notes: 16 paises con revenue en Q1 2026. Ecuador tiene total_reembolsado=0 (COALESCE aplicado correctamente). Mexico lidera ampliamente con $338K neto. Chile aparece en posicion 3 — coherente con la anomalia de pagos narrativa de mar-abr 2026 en el seed.

title: Ejercicio 23
reference_query:
WITH revenue_mensual AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at)::DATE     AS mes,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2)  AS revenue_mes
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status     = 'delivered'
      AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01'
      AND o.ordered_at <  '2027-01-01'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at)
)
SELECT
    mes,
    revenue_mes,
    ROUND(
        SUM(revenue_mes) OVER (
            ORDER BY mes ASC
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ),
        2
    ) AS revenue_acumulado_ytd
FROM revenue_mensual
ORDER BY mes;
notes: 5 filas (ene-may 2026). El acumulado YTD a mayo es $1.69M. Junio 2026 sin datos en el seed. La query filtra < '2027-01-01' para capturar todo 2026 — con el seed actual solo retorna hasta mayo. El revenue de mayo ($192K) es bajo porque el seed fue generado el 2026-05-31 con datos parciales.

title: Ejercicio 24
reference_query:
WITH revenue_producto AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        p.name                                       AS producto,
        cat.category_id,
        cat.name                                     AS categoria,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2)   AS revenue_total
    FROM order_items oi
    INNER JOIN products   p   ON p.product_id   = oi.product_id
    INNER JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, cat.category_id, cat.name
),
con_promedio AS (
    SELECT
        producto,
        categoria,
        revenue_total,
        ROUND(
            AVG(revenue_total) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id),
            2
        ) AS promedio_categoria
    FROM revenue_producto
)
SELECT producto, categoria, revenue_total, promedio_categoria
FROM con_promedio
WHERE revenue_total > promedio_categoria
ORDER BY categoria, revenue_total DESC;
notes: 38 productos de 90 superan el promedio de su categoria. Home Appliances tiene la mayor cantidad de productos por encima del promedio (8) — refleja alta dispersion en esa categoria. Audio tiene el umbral mas alto como categoria (promedio $59.5K).

title: Integrador
reference_query:
-- PARTE A: Análisis MoM H1 2026
WITH revenue_mensual AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at)::DATE     AS mes,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2)  AS revenue_mes
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status     = 'delivered'
      AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01'
      AND o.ordered_at <  '2026-07-01'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at)
)
SELECT
    mes,
    revenue_mes,
    LAG(revenue_mes) OVER (ORDER BY mes)                        AS revenue_anterior,
    ROUND(
        revenue_mes - LAG(revenue_mes) OVER (ORDER BY mes),
        2
    )                                                           AS variacion_absoluta,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_mes - LAG(revenue_mes) OVER (ORDER BY mes))
        / NULLIF(LAG(revenue_mes) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 0),
        1
    )                                                           AS variacion_pct
FROM revenue_mensual
ORDER BY mes;

-- PARTE B: Top 3 productos del semestre
WITH revenue_semestral AS (
    SELECT
        p.name                                       AS producto,
        cat.name                                     AS categoria,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2)   AS revenue_total
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id    = o.order_id
    INNER JOIN products    p  ON p.product_id   = oi.product_id
    INNER JOIN categories  cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
    WHERE o.status     = 'delivered'
      AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01'
      AND o.ordered_at <  '2026-07-01'
    GROUP BY p.name, cat.name
),
ranking AS (
    SELECT
        producto,
        categoria,
        revenue_total,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_total DESC) AS posicion_global
    FROM revenue_semestral
)
SELECT producto, categoria, revenue_total, posicion_global
FROM ranking
WHERE posicion_global <= 3
ORDER BY posicion_global;

-- PARTE C: Críticos e importantes (cuartil 1 en stock Y cuartil 1 en revenue)
WITH revenue_producto AS (
    SELECT
        oi.product_id,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue_total
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status     = 'delivered'
      AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01'
      AND o.ordered_at <  '2026-07-01'
    GROUP BY oi.product_id
),
analisis_doble AS (
    SELECT
        p.name                                          AS producto,
        cat.name                                        AS categoria,
        i.stock,
        COALESCE(r.revenue_total, 0)                    AS revenue_total,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY i.stock ASC)            AS cuartil_stock,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(r.revenue_total, 0) DESC) AS cuartil_revenue
    FROM inventory i
    INNER JOIN products   p   ON p.product_id   = i.product_id
    INNER JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
    LEFT JOIN revenue_producto r ON r.product_id = i.product_id
)
SELECT producto, categoria, stock, revenue_total, cuartil_stock, cuartil_revenue
FROM analisis_doble
WHERE cuartil_stock   = 1    -- 25% de menor stock
  AND cuartil_revenue = 1    -- 25% de mayor revenue en H1 2026
ORDER BY stock ASC, revenue_total DESC;
notes: Resultados reales precalculados desde el dataset SQLite.
